title: [Docs] While developing the assets are generated in /js build we load them from /assets/
body:
Kind of misunderstanding with `jekyll-assets` probably.

Reproduction case:

* `npm run dev:docs`
* edit `search.js` file and save
* the livereload says `js/search.js updated`
* the page includes `/assets/search.js` through the `{{ js search.js }}` directive, so you will always reach the old version of the file, generated at startup time... (struggled 15min on it without understanding what was happening....)

Quick fix:

```html
<script src="{{ "/js/search.js" | prepend: site.baseurl }}"></script>
```

instead of

```
{{ js search.js }}
```
